services.name: Charles L. Honn Botanical Garden
services.desc: The Botanical Garden has been described as a “hidden gem” in Pleasant Valley. The cycles of native plants, flowers and trees make the garden appealing in every season. Plants are identified with signage. It has been designated as an urban bee lab for UC-Berkeley. The garden is open during regular museum hours, and museum members may reserve time in the garden outside of regular museum hours. Visitors find the area relaxing just to sit, eat lunch, or watch the monarchs float over the garden. The Gazebo is a 27' Amish Gazebo beautifully set in the middle of the garden. The gazebo can be reserved by PVHS Museum Members for small meetings or weddings; contact pvhmag@gmail.com. To become a PVHS
